text.intro: Welcome to my first diner! Only a couple of tables to start, but that's enough to get us going. Let's see if me can learn the basics with some standard customers.
text.succeed: Great work! Now we're ready for some real customers. Let's get some more tables in here.
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift.

text.intro: Up to four tables - we're already growing. Now, let's do something to clean up this place. The money from this shift should cover a bunch of repairs.
text.succeed: Alright! Let's fix up these old walls!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Remember: seat the customers, take the order, deliver the food, drop the check, and clean the table.

text.intro: Look what a difference a little paint and tile makes. Now let's see if we can upgrade to a couple of 4-tops.
text.succeed: Great job! That should be enough for two four-top tables.
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Different colored customers means we have to seat them carefully to get the seating bonus.

text.intro: New tables, more customers, we are going places! It's about time we got some new kitchen equipment. Remember to watch the line. People get pretty angry when they wait.
text.succeed: Great work! We earned enough for a coffee machine!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Let's be careful to use the four-top tables for big parties and two-tops for smaller ones.

text.intro: Check out that brand new coffee machine. Give the customers coffee to give them a boost of happiness. But with our growing clientele, we'll need a couple more tables.
text.succeed: That should be enough for a couple more tables. Way to go!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Use the coffee to make customers happier and earn bigger tips.

text.intro: The diner is going strong, but we must be losing customers with that shabby entrance. Maybe today's shift will give us enough for a nice exterior.
text.succeed: Wow! I think can afford more than just a new door. Let's pretty this place up!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough. Let's take particular care of the food critic. Make sure she's really happy, and don't let her leave mad.

text.intro: Check out that new entrance. We're sure to get a whole new type of customers. Another good shift and we'll be able to really make this place shine.
text.succeed: Great work! Let's see how many new decorations we can afford.
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Seniors will wait longer before they get mad, but they also take longer to decide and eat.

text.intro: This place looks terrific! Now, let's get some more tables so we can handle the new rush of customers.
text.succeed: Alright! Let's get a couple more four-tops and open this place up!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. We better keep an eye on the line and watch for angry customers.

text.intro: Wow...from two tables in a dingy shack to all of this. We better be careful though - there are a lot more customers to handle. Let's see if we can earn enough to get a few more red and blue seats for our customers.
text.succeed: Nice job! We're almost ready to grow!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Let's be careful about how we place customers. Color bonuses and good seating can make a shift.

text.intro: Great work! I think we're ready to expand. If we can make it though this shift, we'll have the cash to start a whole new restaurant. Let's do it!
text.succeed: Terrific! That's all we needed to open our second restaurant. Come on!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Remember that if we serve customers quickly, we can give them a happiness boost.

text.intro: What a great day! The diner's going strong, and now I'm opening my new restaurant: Flo's Tiki Palace. Let's see what kind of customers we get now, and whether we can earn enough for some more tables.
text.succeed: What a great opening day! Now, let's get those tables in here.
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. I guess three colors means more careful customer seating.

text.intro: Already the business is starting to pick up. It's about time I got some tiki drinks in here. Maybe we can earn enough this shift for that.
text.succeed: Great job! We earned enough to get some tiki drinks!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. With only four-top tables, we'll need to be careful how we seat parties of one and two.

text.intro: Now this palace is cooking! I'm a little worried about the line though. People get frustrated too quickly. Maybe if I earn enough this shift, I can get something to solve that problem.
text.succeed: That was a good shift. Now let's see what this podium does!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Don't forget to use the tiki drinks to make the customers happier.

text.intro: The new podium is exactly what I needed. If I stand at it, I can talk to the customers in line and eventually make them happier. Hopefully, that will earn me enough to get a couple more tables.
text.succeed: Great work! Bring on the tables!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Remember, if we stand at the podium until the heart fills up, it will make everyone in line happier.

text.intro: The podium seems to be working great and the money is rolling in. I expect I'll see a whole new type of customer now. Well, let's see if I can tiki this palace up a bit with today's earnings
text.succeed: That should be enough to buy a new counter.
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Remember: the longer we do the same action, the bigger the chain bonus!

text.intro: Hmm..those business women tip well, but they're in such a rush to get out. Not like those old men, who don't tip as well but are very patient. I'll have to keep track of how customers act if I want to be successful.
text.succeed: New tables ...here we come!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. We should serve these business women quickly. They get mad quickly, but they tip well.

text.intro: These extra tables were just what I needed. That new table will seat up to six, so I guess I better expect some larger parties. Let's get to work!
text.succeed: Terrific! Now I can finally improve that doorway!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. Chains of four, five or even higher are the key to big earnings. Keep chaining!

text.intro: The tiki palace looks beautiful, and not a moment too soon. My old company's decided to have its annual company lunch here - all business types. I better get ready to do some quick service.
text.succeed: Great work! That should take care of the rest of the tiki decorations!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. With all business women, we're going to have to stay on our toes.

text.intro: We made it through that shift, and got some new tables for our troubles. I still think this restaurant could use a little more flair, though. Let's see what we can earn this shift.
text.succeed: Great work! One step closer to a third restaurant...
text.fail: We didn't earn enough. If we get the customers eating at the same time, we can score big chains and have time for the podium.

text.intro: Flo's Tiki Palace looks spectacular! And I have almost enough saved to open my third restaurant. If we can make it through this shift, I'll have enough for construction. Ready?
text.succeed: Great work!
text.fail: We didn't earn enough this shift. The time when lots of customers are eating is the best time to stop at the podium.
